text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer identifies what is in a picture, such as a cat or a flower. Another task is object detection, which finds and locates multiple objects in one image. These technologies have many practical applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to detect pedestrians, other vehicles, and traffic signs. Doctors also use it to study medical images, and factories use it to check products for mistakes. As computers become smarter, computer vision will play an even bigger role in our world.
